result.title: PURA: Video Token Pruning via Unified Spatiotemporal Redundancy Assessment
result.summary: Video large language models incur substantial inference costs from long visual token sequences. Existing video token compression methods mitigate these costs by exploiting spatial redundancy within frames and temporal redundancy across frames. However, many approaches impose predefined processing orders or fixed allocation ratios for spatial and temporal compression, limiting their ability to adapt to the varying balance of spatiotemporal redundancy across videos. To address this limitation, we propose PURA, a training-free method that prunes visual tokens through unified spatiotemporal redundancy assessment. For each token, PURA constructs spatial and temporal reference candidates and selects the reference with the lowest representation error across the two dimensions. The representation error is combined with token importance to determine each token's removal cost. To avoid the time overhead of removing the lowest-cost token one by one, we introduce Coordinated Pruning, which iteratively groups mutually compatible low-cost removals into batches for simultaneous execution and updates the pruning state after each batch until the target budget is reached. Extensive experiments on three video large language models and five video understanding benchmarks demonstrate that PURA achieves a favorable trade-off between task performance and inference efficiency.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出免训练的视频 token 剪枝方法 PURA，为每个 token 在时空两个维度上构造参考候选并选取表示误差最低者，结合重要度确定删除代价，再用协同剪枝分批删除至目标预算。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「表示误差+重要度」的 token 级冗余与信息损失度量，或可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与细节保留程度的评价线索，但该方法本身面向视频推理加速，未涉及 latent 推理状态或答案对视觉内容的实际使用。
